title: Slip detection in contact-rich manipulation before the object moves
statement: Grippers detect slip only after the object has moved. We need a precursor signal of slip onset from tactile sensing, ideally from the friction instability itself rather than from learned appearance.

title: Predicting measles re-emergence in patchy vaccination landscapes
statement: Incidence returns in regions where coverage is high on average but patchy. We lack a theory of how well-covered patches rescue poorly covered ones and when extinction-recolonisation of the virus tips to persistence.

title: Robust segmentation under domain shift without labelled target data
statement: Segmentation degrades under domain shift; we want estimation that is robust to model uncertainty without target labels.

title: Crack arrest in self-healing ceramic composites
statement: Self-healing fills cracks but does not stop them growing first. We want a mechanism of crack arrest that raises effective fracture toughness before healing acts.
